commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The resulting free kick from Luka Romero (Alaves) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
90+6' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows the yellow card to Renato Tapia (Leganes) for a heavy challenge.
90+4' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) for a tough tackle.
90+3' The foul by Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Isidro Diaz de Mera.
90+2' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+2' The attendance for today's match is 16881.

90+2' Joan Jordan (Alaves) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 1 Carlos Vicente (Alaves) breaks through before collecting a brilliant pass and producing a precise strike to beat the goalkeeper. The ball went into the bottom right corner.
86' Alaves fail to score from a corner as Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes) leaps to collect the ball.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves. The referee blows his whistle, Alaves are awarded a corner kick.
84' Leganes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
82' Borja Jimenez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge Saenz de Miera Colmeiro (Leganes) replacing Diego Garcia.
80' Abdel Abqar (Alaves) is punished with the yellow card.
80' Joan Jordan (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
77' A substitution has been made. Nahuel Tenaglia is replaced by Luka Romero (Alaves).
77' Joan Jordan (Alaves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jon Guridi.
77' Here is a change. Dani Raba is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Julian Chicco (Leganes).
76' Borja Jimenez appears to have said too much and referee Isidro Diaz de Mera comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
75' The game is interrupted now, Dani Raba (Leganes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
73' Dani Raba (Leganes) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
70' Here comes a substitution. Toni Martinez (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Antonio Blanco.
70' It is time for a substitution. Stoichkov is on for Carlos Martin (Alaves).

67' 0 - 1 Dani Raba sends a superb cross into the box. Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) latches on to it and from close range plants a header into the roof of the net, leaving Antonio Sivera beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:1.
65' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Juan Cruz will be replaced by Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes).
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
59' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
57' The resulting corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) is cleared by the defence.
57' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Alaves have a corner.
53' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner.
52' Alaves take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
51' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
50' Alaves take a short corner kick.
48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+1' What a big chance! Carlos Vicente (Alaves) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Renato Tapia (Leganes).
38' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
37' The ball possession is 54:46.
33' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
32' Dani Raba (Leganes) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

32' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Antonio Sivera is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Leganes will take a corner kick.
31' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
29' Moussa Diarra (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
27' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Javi Hernandez (Leganes), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
25' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
23' Diego Garcia (Leganes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) rises high to meet a perfect corner kick and heads from the edge of the box towards the right post, but it isn't strong enough and the goalkeeper makes an easy save.
21' The ball goes out of play. Leganes are awarded a corner kick.
20' Oscar Rodriguez (Leganes) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Leganes win a corner.
19' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

18' Renato Tapia (Leganes) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Antonio Sivera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Leganes have been awarded a corner kick.
17' Jon Guridi (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

16' Dani Raba (Leganes) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
16' Leganes take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
15' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Dani Raba (Leganes), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Leganes have a corner.
14' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) times his run perfectly to connect with a cross from the free kick. Unluckily for him, his header goalwards was blocked by his own teammate.
13' Marko Dmitrovic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Kike Garcia (Alaves) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
12' Alaves seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
9' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Leganes comes to nothing.

9' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Leganes.
6' It looks like Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) saw red with that tackle. Isidro Diaz de Mera won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
5' A quickly taken corner by Alaves.
5' Carlos Martin (Alaves) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Alaves force a corner. They send men into the box.
3' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and Alaves manage to earn a corner.

2' Carlos Martin (Alaves) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the roof of the net lacks power and Marko Dmitrovic easily makes the save. The ball goes out of play and Alaves have been awarded a corner kick.
